Why Studio Nora

CONVEYOR
BELT HAIR.

Every appointment starts with a consultation. We listen to what you want, what your hair is doing and how much time you actually want to spend on it each morning.

No rushed bookings. No double-stacking clients. Colour consultations are always with the same stylist, from the first conversation to the final finish.

  • Dedicated stylist every visit
  • No hidden pricing
  • Colour consultations always free
  • Cancellation up to 24 hours*
